text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu……it's here it's here it's hereee! 
I've got a headache!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yessir! This is simply a side effect from 
my teacher's passionate instruction during 
supplementary lessons!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is, shall we say, a muscle ache for 
the brain……

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sore muscles are a harbinger of growth…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words! I'm smart, and I'm about 
to get even smarter!
choice_data_list: S, so that's how it works…?
S, so that's how it works…?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative! Based on my experience and 
theories, there is no doubt!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let's ride this wave of growth! Both 
physically and mentally, Bakushinbaku――

Despite her enthusiasm, Sakura Bakushin O 
was plagued by a headache.
